## Service

**Program co-chair** — The Sixth International Conference on Quantitative
Ethnography (ICQE24); Poster & Demo Track, 16th International Learning Analytics
& Knowledge Conference (LAK26).

**Editorial board** — *International Journal of Computer-Supported Collaborative
Learning*.

**Program committee** — ICQE (2021–2023); LAK (2021–2026); FLAIRS-33 Intelligent
Learning Technologies.

**Reviewing** — *Journal of the Learning Sciences*, *Journal of Learning
Analytics*, *Computers & Education*, *Computers and Education: Artificial
Intelligence*, *British Journal of Educational Technology*, *Computers in Human
Behavior*, *Artificial Intelligence Review*, *Frontiers in Psychology*,
*ijCSCL*, *Transactions on Learning Technology*, and the ICLS, CSCL, LAK, ICQE
and FLAIRS conferences.

**At Monash** — Education and Analytics Group Coordinator, Department of
Human-Centred Computing; Team Lead, AI Learning Circle; committee member,
Education Transformation Project.
